title: ERCOT HB_HUBAVG: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-24, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, SPP via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables iso_dam_hub_prices, iso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-25.
citations: California Independent System Operator (CAISO); Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT); Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO); Southwest Power Pool (SPP). DAM Settlement Point Prices; Day-Ahead Ex-Post LMP (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]; Day-Ahead LMP by Settlement Location; OASIS Locational Marginal Prices, day-ahead market (DAM). Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `iso_dam_hub_prices`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.

California Independent System Operator (CAISO); Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT); Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO); Southwest Power Pool (SPP). Historical RTM Load Zone and Hub Prices; OASIS Interval Locational Marginal Prices, real-time dispatch (RTD, 5-minute); RTBM LMP by Settlement Location, 5-minute; Real-Time Final Market LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]; Real-Time Preliminary Ex-Post LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]; Settlement Point Prices at Resource Nodes, Hubs and Load Zones. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `iso_rtm_hub_prices`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.
facts: ERCOT HB_HUBAVG, 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-24: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 18:00 local, 8.08 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 15:00, -1.07 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-24: 4.26 USD/MWh.
